issue: सोमयज्ञ महापुण्यं एकबिल्वं शिवार्पणम् — the verse names the gift of a śālagrāma and the merit of a Soma sacrifice beside the refrain, with no word for how they compare.
our reading: Equal to these is one bilva leaf offered to Śiva (the bilva offering stands in apposition to the merits listed); a footnote gives the other reading.
alternatives: The bilva offering surpasses them (many commentators; the sanskritdocuments.org meaning of śloka 5: "cannot be compared"). The same applies to sh5, sh7 and kashi.

issue: नन्दिकेश्वर is often the name of Nandī himself.
our reading: Śiva, the lord of Nandī (the verse is about worshipping Śiva with the bilva; the sanskritdocuments.org meaning reads it so).
alternatives: Nandikeśvara as Nandī: when Nandī is worshipped with an unbroken bilva leaf.

issue: The owner's text numbers ślokas 1–7, leaves the Kāśī śloka unnumbered and numbers मूलतो ब्रह्मरूपाय… as 8; the sanskritdocuments.org printout numbers all ten verses 1–10.
our reading: The owner's numbering (eight numbered ślokas, an aṣṭaka).
alternatives: The printout's 1–10 (Kāśī 8, मूलतो 9, phalaśruti 10); item ids would not change.
